source_book: The Brand Relationship Spectrum — Aaker & Joachimsthaler (2000)

test_cases.prompt: Map our brand portfolio — we have a master, a few endorsed brands, and some subbrands, and I'm not sure how they relate.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-spectrum; place each offering on the spectrum by driver-role share and produce a portfolio map.

test_cases.prompt: Explain the difference between a House of Brands and a Branded House to my team.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-spectrum; explain the two extremes and the driver-role gradient.

test_cases.prompt: How are these sub-brands and endorsed brands related to our master in terms of brand architecture?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-spectrum; classify each on the spectrum.

test_cases.prompt: Should this new product be a subbrand or its own separate brand?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate aaker-relation-spectrum; activate aaker-relation-select-separation (the positioning decision).
test_cases.notes: Sibling-confusion bait: this is the decision, not the map.

test_cases.prompt: Our master brand is getting diluted by too many extensions. Help.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate aaker-relation-spectrum; activate aaker-relation-avoid-pitfalls (dilution risk).
test_cases.notes: Sibling-confusion bait: risk triage, not framework mapping.

test_cases.prompt: Our logo looks dated — suggest a redesign.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate (this is visual/design work, outside brand architecture structure). Redirect to design.

notes: ≥3 should_trigger + 2 should_not_trigger (one sibling bait each: aaker-relation-select-separation, aaker-relation-avoid-pitfalls) + 1 edge. All should_not_trigger must pass.
